gbm_population_evidence.quote: radiologically confirmed (MRI and/or PET with amino-acids) diagnosis of high-grade glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: After enrollment patientswith radiological signs of HGG will be irradiated by pencil beam protons

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Standard treatment and follow-up: Chemoradiotherapy with a scanned proton beam combined with temozolomide 75 mg/m²

role_evidence.quote: Adjuvant chemotherapy with temozolomide 150-200 mg/m² on a 5/23 schedule (maintenance chemotherapy), for 12 cycles or until disease progression/unacceptable toxicity.

coder_notes: Glioblastoma is mentioned only in the detailed description; conditions and eligibility say high-grade glioma. Intervention is preoperative proton radiotherapy; temozolomide appears only as the subsequent standard treatment described in the brief summary (not a registered intervention), listed per manual section 3.
